briefdescription.para: Multimap tracking debug users in current BB.
getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
Remove instruction Copy if there exists a previous copy that copies the register Src to the register Def; This may happen indirectly by copying the super registers.
Look for available copies whose destination register is used by MI and replace the use in MI with the copy's source register.
Decide whether we should forward the source of.

parameterdescription.para: based on the physical register class constraints of the opcode and avoiding introducing more cross-class COPYs.

inbodydescription.para: COPYs don't have register class constraints, so if the user instruction is a COPY, we just try to avoid introducing additional cross-class COPYs. For example:
RegClassA = COPY RegClassB // Copy parameter ... RegClassB = COPY RegClassA // UseI parameter
RegClassA = COPY RegClassB ... RegClassB = COPY RegClassB
so we have reduced the number of cross-class COPYs and potentially introduced a nop COPY that can be removed.

briefdescription.para: Check that MI does not have implicit uses that overlap with it's Use operand (the register being replaced), since these can sometimes be implicitly tied to other operands.

detaileddescription.para: the VGPR2 is implicitly tied to the larger reg operand, but we have no way of knowing we need to update the latter when updating the former.

briefdescription.para: For an MI that has multiple definitions, check whether MI has a definition that overlaps with another of its definitions.

detaileddescription.para: For example, on ARM: umull r9, r9, lr, r0 The umull instruction is unpredictable unless RdHi and RdLo are different.

briefdescription.para: Return true if it is safe to update all users of the CopySrc register in the given Copy instruction.
